title: Book 9 — Calliope, Chapter 119
paragraphs: Now Oiobazos, as he was escaping into Thrace, was caught by the Apsinthian Thracians and sacrificed to their native god Pleistoros by their rites, and the rest who were with him they slaughtered in another manner. But Artaÿctes and his companions, who started their flight later and were overtaken a little way above Aegospotami, defended themselves for a considerable time; some of them were killed and others taken alive. The Greeks bound these and were bringing them to Sestos — Artaÿctes among them in bonds together with his son.
